metadata.description: Code Knowledge Graph (CKG) — structure-aware retrieval for coding agents. Parses Python codebases into typed graphs (import/call/co-edit edges), optionally stores them in Oracle AI Database PGQ, and injects a dependency-aware structure map on coding prompts so Claude Code finds the right files faster.

plugins.name: ckg
plugins.description: Code Knowledge Graph — transparent background dependency analysis. Builds a typed code graph and adds a compact structure map to coding prompts: the files the prompt names plus their import/call/co-edit neighbours, most relevant first.
